additional_info.subject: ID0434641-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP/S3170003460] Charging cannot be done at the dispenser outlet CRM:00798002265
additional_info.body:
Hi Yunus,
We did the log analysis of the Charger.
We have identified couple of issues. Our Observations are as follows:
First of all, Charger is at v6.1.3,
We recommend having same at latest FW i.e.v7.0.5
We could see couple of charging sessions, But as reported on Outlet 3 & 4, Charging is not happening,
We have identified the root cause as FC2 is tripped. And due to that whole dispenser operation came to halt.
We need to untrip it or replace it.
Additionally, We could see the Main fan is having error.
We need to investigate as per following KA.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_FAN_Error Flag_OK Signal Lost -
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_Mainfan_GQ1_Ok Signal Lost-Fan rotation disabled -
Along with that, We have observed that couple of converters have the Fastshutdown. So we need to swap with adjacent one and validate.
As of now, All converter seems to be healthy.
